leak_rule: Join with available_from <= decision_date (using merge_asof or strict inequality), then execute on decision_date + 1. Never backdate restatements.
caveats: Covers top US-GAAP filers only (~63 of top 80 market cap; foreign ADRs / non-GAAP filers omitted).
Does not contain analyst consensus estimates (no surprise vs consensus).
Survivorship caveat: universe selected from current top market-cap firms (PITFALLS #7) — any backtest using this panel must note large-cap current-constituent selection bias.
